feeds.title: IAA Blog
feeds.description: The Italian American Alliance (IAA) stands against discrimination against ALL people and particularly against discrimination pointed at Italians or Italian Americans. The Alliance promotes mutual cooperation among its members, reinforces social welfare ideals with community involvement, and preserves the historical significance and achievements of Italians and Italian Americans.

feeds.title: Red Sauce Blog
feeds.description: Red Sauce is the cuisine created by Italian Immigrants arriving during the great migration. Explore the Red Sauce blog on the website and get to know recipes, fun stories that didn't make it into the book, and new research in the history of Italian American food.

feeds.title: Hardcore Italians Blog
feeds.description: Hardcore Italians are the ultimate entertainment website for Italian Americans. We cover everything that encompasses Italian culture and lifestyle including news, recipes, travel, sports, music, fashion, art, history, humor, and more. At Hardcore Italians we have one mission: Celebrate Italian heritage. We aim to inspire the Italian community to appreciate and connect with their roots. We genuinely hope to bring laughter, memories, and joy to other Italian-Americans.

feeds.title: Memorie di Angelina
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Frank. Memoires di Angelina blog is my tribute to the home cooking of my nonna Angelina with Easy Authentic Italian Recipes. You'll find Angelina's specialties here, along with the classic dishes I got to know during my years in Italy. You'll also find articles with essential background and techniques for making authentic Italian food, in-depth information on the Italian Pantry and food culture, and tips and tricks, like how to choose the best-canned tomatoes.

feeds.title: Sip and Feast
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Jim and I'm here to help you make awesome Italian food that you would normally enjoy at some of your favorite New York-style Italian restaurants. Sip and Feast specialize in Italian and Italian-American food you'd often find in the New York metro area. You'll find big flavors and detailed instructions on how to make some of the most famous dishes along with less well-known family favorites.

feeds.title: ITMCAP Blog
feeds.description: We strive to help Italian Americans pursue their goals, obtain the citizenship rights and privileges they deserve, and streamline the complex processes and paperwork that might be standing in the way of their dreams. The Italian American Citizenship Assistance Program invites you to learn more about Italy and dual citizenship in the Italian blog posts.

feeds.title: Big Mamma's Italian American Cooking
feeds.description: Big Mamma's Italian American Cooking is a collection of recipes from Teresa Lapetina Greco (Big Mamma), her daughter Elizabeth Greco Noviello (Mamaw), her granddaughter Marie Noviello Casazza and her great-granddaughter-in-law Lee Casazza. Browse the website and read many different recipes from Italian cuisine.

feeds.title: Italian American Herald
feeds.description: Welcome to the Delaware Valley Italian-American Herald, a community monthly dedicated to spreading the love for all things Italian. Find new features every month about food, language, history, heritage, wine, and much more.

feeds.title: L'Italo-Americano
feeds.description: L'Italo-Americano Newspaper is a non-profit organization. A biweekly publication serving the Italian-American community throughout the United States. Established in 1908, L'Italo-Americano is the oldest Italian-American newspaper in the US with a mission to promote and preserve Italian culture and heritage by reporting in both Italian and English on subjects such as arts and culture, literature, education, history, business, sciences, sports, lifestyle to name a few.

feeds.title: Proud Italian Cook
feeds.description: I'm Marie, a wife, mother, mother-in-law, and gramma of two beautiful girls. My passion is food, clear and simple but especially Italian food, hence the name of my blog, Proud Italian Cook. My blog is about sharing traditional recipes as well as updating some of the classics with a more modern and contemporary flair.

feeds.title: Our Italian Table
feeds.description: A tavola non s'invecchia

feeds.title: Cookingitaliancomfortfood
feeds.description: If you're a fan of Italian cuisine, you won't want to miss Cooking Italian Comfort Food. Founded by Peter, this blog is dedicated to exploring the world of Italian comfort food. From hearty pasta to delicious pizzas and more, you'll find everything you need to create your own comforting Italian dishes at home.

feeds.title: Italian Sons and Daughters of America » Culture
feeds.description: Italian Sons and Daughters of America is a community for Italian Americans.

feeds.title: Always From Scratch
feeds.description: Always from scratch is a place where you will find easy and delicious (mostly Italian) that you can cook and eat with your family!

feeds.title: An American in Italy
feeds.description: An American in Italy is a blog full of advice for American ex-pats living in Italy, written by an author Jessica Scott Romano who is learning it all on the fly and sharing her knowledge as she goes. Explore the blog to learn more about her adventures in Italy and get more important fun tips.

feeds.title: Italianità Blog
feeds.description: With this blog, I will explore the culture and history of Italians and Italian-Americans. I will examine the forces that shaped who we are as well as our possible paths into the future. I will also travel down the road less traveled, if you will pardon the cliché, to explore some of the lesser-known aspects of our culture. It is my sincere desire to share with all of you the excitement and fun of Italy, Italians, and Italian-Americans.

feeds.title: An American in Rome Blog
feeds.description: An American in Rome is your essential guide to Rome, Italy, and beyond - from someone who actually lives here. You will find hundreds of personally vetted recommendations for what to do in Rome, where to eat, how to get around, and what you shouldn't waste your time or money on.

feeds.title: Italian-American Culture & Heritage Blog
feeds.description: Celebrating Our Italian-American Roots

feeds.title: Cooking with Mamma C
feeds.description: Recipes from My Italian-American Kitchen

feeds.title: Italian American Girl
feeds.description: A cultural online resource about growing up Italian American in the USA. Join me as I open up my discussions on the journey of growing up with strong Italian values in America. Then, follow me on my day to day experiences on family, life, travel, food, arts, culture, career, celebrity and mainstream media.

feeds.title: The Italian Californian Blog
feeds.description: TheItalianCalifornian.com will be a gateway to everything Italian and Italian American in California. Here you will find directories with useful links to Italian and Italian American social, cultural, charitable, and professional organizations, Italian neighborhoods and enclaves in California, and museums. and cultural centers, as well as sources that can educate you on the history of Italians in the Golden State.
